correctness.rationale: For distinct a_1,...,a_n (n>=2) in universal homogeneous parity 3-hypergraph, a fixed graphing g on parameters and a binary star vector t on an added point satisfy X_ij=g_ij+t_i+t_j. Simultaneous complement t->t+1 changes nothing, so the support is an affine cut space of dimension n-1. Braunfeld-Jahel-Marimon Corollary 5.4 explicitly gives every complete n-parameter singleton type equal mass 2^{-(n-1)} (NOT merely a log-based claim), hence uniformity. Restriction to any F is the incidence map of ([n],F), whose kernel comprises componentwise-constant t, rank n-c(F). Affine uniform marginal entropy is n-c(F); independent fair bits iff rank=|F| iff F acyclic. On cycles, summing star equations cancels t and equals triangulated R on fixed parameters. Independently re-enumerated n=5 four-cycle marginal: exactly eight equally likely patterns of 32 star strings, rank 3; source verifier checks rank and incidence through n<=7. The symbolic rank theorem, not this finite test, establishes all n.
